title: Providence Bruins vs. Laval Rocket: Sonic the Hedgehog Weekend
description: The Feb. 20, 2027, matchup at Amica Mutual Pavilion combines Bruins–Rocket hockey with Sonic-themed jerseys, a video-game presentation and advertised fan activities.

title: Antique Dolls Exhibit at Fred and Addie Drummond Home, Feb. 3–28
description: The February exhibit focuses on early-1900s dolls made with materials including bisque, porcelain and leather, with German-made examples by Armand Marseille, Kestner and Koppelsdorf. Visitors can also tour the 1905 Drummond Home.

title: Family Storytime at Kenton Library
description: The half-hour session is Friday, Dec. 18, at 11:30 a.m. Attendance is limited and places are first come, first served.

title: Central Library Tour: 45-Minute Walking Tour in Portland
description: A one-hour event window holds a 45-minute walk through a downtown library that opened in 1913 and reopened after renovations in 2024. The tour’s route is not published.

title: Naughty or Nice Holiday Party at Nautilus Pier 4
description: The listing names a DJ but not the performer, and describes dinner and party-only entry as separate options. It labels the party free, while leaving age policy and any separate cover conditions unclear.

title: Sahakhom Day at the Asian Art Museum: Cambodian Community Day, Dec. 6, 2026
description: The museum’s Cambodian Community Day includes a traditional water blessing and Khmer dance performances, alongside drop-in art, mahjong, family storytelling and gallery tours. The cultural program has no posted performance times.

title: Dutch Oven Gathering: Cast-Iron Cooking at Fort Towson
description: At this quarterly community-led demonstration, visitors can follow the cooking process from fire or charcoal through heat management, with samples scheduled at noon. Watching is free; cooking participants must register.

title: Toddler Storytime at Kenton Library — Dec. 11, 2026
description: Interactive stories, songs and games make up this 30-minute session for toddlers and a favorite adult. Attendance is limited and first come, first served.

title: Bridget Everett at The 5th Avenue Theatre — March 6, 2027
description: An all-ages, reserved-seating booking in STG’s Comedy category. The announcement names Bridget Everett but does not describe the show’s format, give an end time or list a ticket price.

title: Lego Club: LEGO Display Building at Midland Library
description: On Dec. 10, children can build LEGO displays intended to decorate Midland Library. Grades K–5 are the guide; younger and older siblings are welcome, and the library provides the building blocks.

title: Look up for Felix the Cat
description: The 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade moves to Saturday, November 28, 2026. See the New York route, new TV times and returning balloons.

title: Across to Bainbridge on foot
description: Take the Bainbridge Island ferry from Seattle on foot. Check round-trip fares, walk-on boarding, holiday sailings, the free art museum and two Winslow waterfront walks.

title: Calle Ocho over coffee
description: Walk Miami’s Little Havana from Cuban Memorial Boulevard to Domino Park, Tower Theater and a Cuban coffee stop. Find park hours, trolley service and what to order.

title: The trees Chicago makes together
description: Plan Christmas Around the World at Chicago’s Museum of Science and Industry. Find six trees on the 2026 map, compare tickets and check holiday hours.

title: The two faces of Mammoth Cave
description: Compare three Mammoth Cave National Park tours by stairs, distance and ticket price. Find the winter schedule for Mammoth Passage, Frozen Niagara and Domes & Dripstones.

title: Two pools and a long evening at Hearst Castle
description: Compare Hearst Castle tour tickets in San Simeon, California. See the Neptune and Roman pools, Holiday Twilight dates, stairs, shuttle and accessible routes.

title: Where winter starts above Palm Springs
description: Plan the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway in winter. Check online fares, walk-up tickets, parking, holiday hours and closures, Long Valley snow and short hikes.

title: The trains that stayed in Brooklyn
description: Visit the New York Transit Museum in Brooklyn, compare tickets and accessibility, and find the Sunday 2026 Holiday Nostalgia Train and free Grand Central show.

title: Stay for the last light at White Sands
description: Plan a winter visit to White Sands National Park near Alamogordo, New Mexico. Compare Dunes Drive hikes, sledding slopes, $25 admission, sunset hours and the boardwalk closure.

title: Honolulu’s finish line waits
description: Plan the Honolulu Marathon on Dec. 13. The race starts at 5 a.m. and the start line closes at 5:30 a.m. Check the course, fees, 10K finish and zoo shuttle.
